name: Radiance Town: Radiant Devotees use textured suit displays (#11424)
contract: The installed client has no baked NPC texture for 32630, 47042 or 47043, so a Radiant Devotee 161786 with one of them renders green. Each index uses the approved #6747 stand-in of the same race, sex and suit whose texture the client has: index 0 the dwarf diving suit 25525, index 1 keeps 14656, index 2 the gnome male space suit 6981 and index 3 the gnome female space suit 6982. This checks server display selection, not client rendering.

steps.label: Let the player finish logging in
DISCRIMINATING: Devotee index 0 is the textured dwarf diving suit 25525, not 32630
DISCRIMINATING: Devotee index 2 is the textured gnome male space suit 6981, not 47042
